problems.label: Our CRM is a mess
problems.move: Audit stages, properties, and ownership against how the team actually sells.

problems.label: Leads fall through handoffs
problems.move: Map every handoff from inquiry to owner and define the next action at each stage.

problems.label: Nobody trusts the reports
problems.move: Agree on definitions first, then rebuild the few reports leadership actually uses.

problems.label: Data lives in ten places
problems.move: Decide which system owns which data, then connect the rest instead of duplicating it.

problems.label: Too much manual busywork
problems.move: List the repeat tasks, automate the routine path, and route exceptions to a person.

problems.label: We want AI agents that do real work
problems.move: Pick one bounded job, give the agent context and tools, and keep review where judgment matters.

problems.label: Key info is stuck in PDFs and pages
problems.move: Define the schema, extract candidates with AI, and approve fields before they become trusted data.

problems.label: We need an internal tool, fast
problems.move: Prototype the smallest useful version in days, put it in front of users, then harden it.

plan.label: Observe + map
plan.copy: Shadow the team, trace the real process, and document where work and data break.

plan.label: Measure + learn
plan.copy: Track adoption and handoff speed, cut what nobody uses, and document how the system runs.
